Part 1: What Is Tracing. Tracing is when one places a source image beneath a translucent medium and follows its lines. This is distinct from 'referencing,' which is distinct from 'inspiration,' which is distinct from 'homage' (see Part 7). Consider Sephiroth: is he a trace of Cloud? No. He is a reflection.
